name: Jison-in Temple
heritage: Important Cultural Property of Japan; part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
text: Jison-in (慈尊院) is a Buddhist temple in the town of Kudoyama that marks the entrance to the pilgrimage route of Koyasan.

depictions.name: Jison-in
depictions.text: Jison-in (慈尊院) is a Buddhist temple in the town of Kudoyama in Japan's Wakayama Prefecture—formerly the province of Kii. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the temple and recovered two lost pages scattered around its grounds.
